allow_anonymous.description: If true, allow ANONYMOUS auth mechanism (insecure unless explicitly designed)

fork.description: If true, fork into background (equivalent to <fork/>)

include_dir_ignore_missing.description: If true, missing files in include_dir are ignored

keep_umask.description: If true, retain original umask after forking

limits.description: Resource limits as list of {name: <str>, value: <int>}; mapped to dict internally for rendering (e.g., {"max_completed_connections": 512, "max_message_size": 64}) — rendered as {name: value} pairs in <limit> elements

listen_addresses.description: List of D-Bus addresses to listen on (e.g., 'unix:path=...', 'tcp:host=localhost,port=0')

policies.description: List of policy blocks, each with context/at_console/user/group and list of allow/deny rules

policies[].at_console.description: If true, applies to console sessions; if false, to non-console

run_as_user.description: Username or UID to run daemon as (e.g., messagebus, root, _example)

selinux_associations.description: List of name-to-SELinux-context mappings for own permissions

selinux_associations[].context.description: SELinux target context for acquiring the name (e.g., 'foo_t')

selinux_enabled.description: If true, enable SELinux configuration (must have <selinux> block)

service_dirs.description: List of directories to search for .service files (system or session)

servicehelper.description: SetUID helper to launch system services (e.g., /usr/lib/dbus-1.0/dbus-daemon-launch-helper)

standard_session_servicedirs.description: If true, use standard session service directories (session bus only)

standard_system_servicedirs.description: If true, use standard system service directories (system bus only)

syslog.description: If true, log to syslog (command-line overrides)
